_comment: Optional data file for gen-agent-stubs.py (--config). Every case-specific default lives here, never in the script: folder layout, the memory server whose tools every persona must keep (T91), MCP servers granted to every persona, per-agent defaults and extra tools, extra stub rules. Copy it into the case, rename the example agents and servers, delete what you do not need. Tool words: read, search, edit, terminal, task, browser, web, todo, memory.
stub_rules: Knowledge-base artifacts are written in the language the rules file names.
